segments.prompt:
3:4 vertical, 11 seconds, minimalist studio product film for a quiet luxury handbag brand, one continuous take, smooth slow handheld drift, bright soft even studio light, calm and unhurried pacing.

@Image1 is the Velantra Bow Tote from the front, @Image2 shows its open top and interior, @Image3 shows it at a three quarter angle. The bag in every frame matches these references exactly: a small ivory cotton canvas tote with a boat shaped silhouette, two ivory canvas top handles, a denim blue canvas ribbon with white contrast stitching threaded through gold oval grommets and tied in a neat bow at the front center, tiny gold metal feet on the base, and an interior fully lined in a cream fabric with a small blue floral print plus a matching floral slip pocket. No logos anywhere on the bag.

Scene: a young woman with fair skin wearing a boxy white t shirt and a flowing black midi skirt stands behind a waist high grey concrete plinth in front of a plain warm white studio wall. Her head and face stay above the top edge of the frame for the entire video, only her torso, arms and hands are ever visible. The room is empty, bare wall and bare plinth, no props, no furniture, nothing else in frame.

[0:00 to 0:02] Camera: tight close up, the bag fills most of the frame in front of her torso, she holds it out toward the camera by both ivory handles and it hangs and sways gently, the denim bow centered and crisp. Light: soft even studio light from the front left. Background: plain warm white wall, softly out of focus.

[0:02 to 0:04] Camera: drifts slightly right as she lowers the bag onto the concrete plinth in side profile, the handles arc upward, the denim ribbon and gold grommets catch the light. Her hands steady the bag from behind.

[0:04 to 0:06] Camera: holds close while both her hands pull the top of the bag open wide toward the camera, revealing the cream interior with its blue floral print lining and the matching floral slip pocket, the canvas flexes softly.

[0:06 to 0:08] Camera: she tilts the open bag toward the lens for one beat so the floral interior stays visible, then lets the top relax and traces the denim bow on the front with one finger.

[0:08 to 0:11] Camera: she lifts the bag and hangs it from her forearm, turning a few degrees so it sits in a clean side silhouette close to the lens, then holds nearly still for the final two seconds.

On screen text: a persistent caption in small clean white sans serif type sits at the bottom center of the frame for the entire 11 seconds and reads exactly: A closer look at the Bow Tote. From 0:08 until the end an additional wordmark in thin elegant white serif capital letters appears centered over the bag and reads exactly: VELANTRA. All text is crisp, level, small and understated. No other text, numbers or watermarks anywhere in the frame.

Audio: quiet studio room tone only, soft canvas handling sounds, no voice, no music.
